data.mutagen_message: You feel your face, scalp, and neck stretch and change into something greater.

data.description: Big, strong, fierce, brave, and a loyal friend, always leading with horns.
Your skin is getting tougher.  Greatly improves protection against all sorts of damage.  Makes you less dextrous though.
Your skin is developing Kevlar-like qualities.  Makes you slower though, and is rather cumbersome.
You are capable of carrying inhuman amounts - more than others with similar strength could.  Your maximum weight carried is increased by 70%.
Your mouth has reshaped to accommodate many serrated teeth.  They make it impossible to wear mouthgear and difficult to eat… but tear giant wounds in your prey.
